# PiTTy v0.6.62

- **Fixed:** Custom two-lane compaction streaming no longer overflows its panel or pushes the following transcript off-screen on short terminals.
- **Height-aware:** Expanded and collapsed lane previews have a bounded row budget based on terminal height.
- **Width-aware:** Long progress labels and uninterrupted streamed lines stay within their panel width.
- **Completed summaries:** Read in a bounded scrollbox instead of expanding the entire transcript.
- **Regression tests:** Real OpenTUI rendering confirms the following content stays visible on a 16-row terminal.

Upgrade with `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.62`. A staged upgrade activates on the next PiTTy launch without interrupting the current session.
